dataSafetyEvidence.automaticAppUploads: No account, profile sync, note upload, FCM, analytics or crash-report SDK in current native implementation

dataSafetyEvidence.userInitiatedShare: Only the selected verse/reference/link or prayer text is sent to the app chosen by the user
pendingServerFacts: whether IP is used to infer location or for profiling
any server-side analytics or third-party processors
dataSafetyEvidence.transport: API and calendar media use HTTPS; no claim of encryption at rest for local preferences

externalSteps: Create a new app in the existing verified Play Console account
Enable Play App Signing and upload the signed AAB to internal testing
Confirm support contact, distribution countries, audience, content rating and declarations
Publish and check the Android privacy URL before closed/public testing
Obtain the Play App Signing SHA-256 certificate for App Links, not the upload-key fingerprint
Test Play installation and updates on real devices; inspect pre-launch reports
For applicable personal accounts: 12 continuously opted-in closed testers for at least 14 days, then apply for production access
Review and explicitly approve the first public rollout
